title: Analista de RH - Talentos e Cultura (Alphaville, Barueri/SP)
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

A Coplan não é apenas um escritório contábil. Somos uma infraestrutura de decisão para empresas em crescimento, atuando de forma estratégica ao lado da liderança para gerar clareza, direção e resultados sustentáveis.

Buscamos um perfil para ocupar a posição de Analista de RH com atuação madura e visão consultiva, para ser o ponto focal do time de Talentos e Cultura em nossa unidade de São Paulo.

Essa posição exige autonomia, capacidade analítica e forte habilidade de relacionamento com lideranças. Aqui, o RH não é operacional — é parte ativa da estratégia do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) da liderança local, apoiando a tomada de decisões relacionada à gestão de pessoas com base em dados, contexto e evidências.
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e revisar Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), garantindo clareza de metas, evolução contínua e alinhamento com o negócio.
  • Identificar nuances comportamentais, dinâmicas de relacionamento e riscos organizacionais, atuando de forma preventiva para promover um ambiente saudável e produtivo.
  • Conduzir ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, feedbacks estruturados e reuniões de alinhamento (1:1).
  • Liderar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção, com foco em fit cultural, comportamental e aderência à estratégia da Coplan.
  • Conduzir o onboarding estruturado de novos colaboradores, assegurando integração, alinhamento cultural e clareza de expectativas.
  • Realizar avaliações de período de experiência e entrevistas de desligamento, contribuindo com análises qualitativas e recomendações à liderança.

O que esperamos dessa posição:

Encontrar um profissional que contribua ativamente para o desenvolvimento das lideranças, fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e evolução da maturidade de gestão de pessoas na unidade de São Paulo, atuando como um verdadeiro ponto de conexão entre estratégia, pessoas e resultados.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Gestão de RH, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Desenvolvimento Humano, com atuação prática em PDI, feedback e suporte a lideranças.
  • Vivência em ambientes organizacionais que exigem autonomia, leitura de contexto e tomada de decisão com agilidade.
  • Perfil relacional e consultivo, com capacidade de influenciar líderes e gerar confiança.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Alphaville – SP.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Certificação ou experiência prática em Coaching.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de avaliação de perfil comportamental (DISC, PDA, Sólides ou similares).
  • Pós-graduação em Liderança, Desenvolvimento de Pessoas ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência anterior em RH com viés consultivo e atuação próxima à liderança.

Carga Horária:

  • Regime híbrido (após período de experiência) – 44h semanais
    • Segunda a quinta: 08h às 18h
    • Sexta-feira: 08h às 17h

Benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível (Descontando apenas R$ 1,00);
  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação R$ 33,00 por dia;
  • Adicional Multibenefícios
  • Assistência Médica após período de experiência;
  • Assistência Odontológica após período de experiência;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Convênio com SESC;
  • Convênio com instituições de Ensino;
  • Parceria de descontos com instituições de Ensino
  • TotalPass;
  • Bonificação por metas;
  • Day Off no mês de aniversário;
  • Plano de Carreira;

title: Banco de Talentos | Profissionais do Turismo
description:
Nós somos a CVC Corp, o maior grupo de viagens das Américas, formado por marcas que atuam nos segmentos de viagens de férias e lazer, viagens corporativas e programas de estudo e intercâmbio cultural no exterior. A evolução, a expertise e o pioneirismo das nossas marcas impactam o mercado e a economia, com o propósito de embarcar com você pelo mundo, proporcionando as melhores experiências todos os dias.

Acreditamos que essa missão só se realiza porque contamos com pessoas diversas, talentosas e comprometidas. Por isso, estamos fortalecendo o nosso Banco de Talentos PCD, criado para receber profissionais que desejam construir sua jornada conosco e contribuir com diferentes perspectivas para transformar o turismo no Brasil.

Aqui, formamos um time que busca evolução constante, protagonismo e inovação, sempre com respeito, inclusão e abertura para novas histórias. Valorizamos ambientes acessíveis, processos transparentes e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Se você busca um lugar onde seu talento é reconhecido e sua trajetória importa, queremos te conhecer.

Venha com a gente fazer parte dessa transformação.

#cvccorpcomvc

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que é:

  • Banco de talentos destinado exclusivamente para profissionais do Turismo.

O que buscamos:

  • Profissionais que queiram crescer em um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e que valoriza a individualidade,
  • Talentos com diferentes experiências, formações e perspectivas;
  • Pessoas com interesse em aprender, se desenvolver e contribuir para transformar a jornada de viagem dos nossos clientes.

Como funciona:

  • Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará disponível para análise da nossa equipe de Atração e Seleção,
  • Quando surgirem vagas afirmativas para profissionais do Turismo alinhadas ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato;
  • Caso necessário, solicitaremos informações complementares ou convidaremos você para etapas específicas do processo;
  • A CVC Corp disponibiliza recursos e adaptações razoáveis conforme a necessidade de cada candidato.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência na área de Turismo e algum dos sistemas: GDS, SABRE, E-GOL, AMADEUS, INFOTRAVEL, JUNIPER.
  • Preferencialmente residir em São Paulo – capital ou região do ABC;
  • Formação em Turismo.

PARA O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Auxílio Creche e Filho com Deficiência

CUIDAR DA SAÚDE E BEM-ESTAR

Inscreva-se nessa oportunidade!

Esperamos que você tenha

  • Experiência em vendas B2B complexas (SaaS / consultiva / ciclo longo).
  • Experiência com negociações complexas e fechamento (closer) em ticket médio/alto.

E será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência estruturando área comercial do zero (processos, playbook, pipeline e rituais).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas (canais/alianças).
  • Vivência de trabalho integrado com Produto (feedback de mercado, posicionamento e discovery comercial).

  • Atuação em ambiente de startup, com foco em crescimento e estruturação.
  • Atuação relevante no ecossistema de tecnologia voltado ao varejo digital.

Além disso, procuramos uma pessoa com mentalidade de construção e forte capacidade de execução, que combine visão estratégica com disciplina para operar no dia a dia, influenciar stakeholders e sustentar resultados em ciclos comerciais longos.

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido

Local: São Paulo – SP (ZS - Berrini)

title: Software Engineer, Athelas Home
description:
At Commure, our mission is to simplify healthcare. We have bold ambitions to reimagine the healthcare experience, setting a new standard for how care is delivered and experienced across the industry. Our growing suite of AI solutions spans ambient AI clinical documentation, provider copilots, autonomous coding, revenue cycle management and more — all designed for providers & administrators to focus on what matters most: providing care.

Healthcare is a $4.5 trillion industry with more than $500 billion spent annually on administrative costs, and Commure is at the heart of transforming it. We power over 500,000 clinicians across hundreds of care sites nationwide – more than $10 billion flows through our systems and we support over 100 million patient interactions. With new product launches on the horizon, expansion into additional care segments, and a bold vision to tackle healthcare's most pressing challenges, our ambition is to move from upstart innovator to the industry standard over the next few years.

Commure was recently named to Fortune’s Future 50 list for 2025 and is backed by world-class investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Y Combinator, Lux, Human Capital, 8VC, Greenoaks Capital, Elad Gil, and more. Commure has achieved over 300% year-over-year growth for the past two years and this is only the beginning. Healthcare's moment for AI-powered transformation is here, and we're building the technology to power it. Come join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

About the Role

Commure is on the lookout for Software Engineers to join our Athelas Home Engineering team, playing a pivotal role in enhancing our FDA-cleared IoT medical device product. The Athelas Home is a portable device that segments and counts the hematology composition of an individual's blood. Our product captures high resolution imagery of a blood sample and utilizes an ML model to determine the concentration of white blood cells using a few drops of blood. Hardware, software, and chemistry come together in concert to produce a streamlined, efficient, and powerful diagnostics platform whose results are as accurate as gold‑standard devices at a fraction of the cost. Today, these devices are deployed and active across the world, making bloodwork more comfortable for patients and more accessible for their doctors.

This position is perfect for someone who has experience with full stack software engineering; enjoys building new features and improving infrastructure, and has an interest in the medical device R&D space. You’ll be working in a small multi‑functional engineering team comprised of chemical and hardware engineering, manufacturing, and quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Development of existing backend and frontend services for the Athelas device product: improving our infrastructure, architecting and building robust, scalable back‑end service
  • Translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Implementation of cybersecurity best practices throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, quality, and regulatory functions to ensure that production software systems meet both operational, security, and regulatory requirements
  • Utilize a stack comprising Python, Flask, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Apply problem‑solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring the stability and performance of our systems
  • Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience required
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience required, proficiency in Python
  • Deep expertise in developing and managing data pipelines and experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational database management systems
  • Advanced knowledge in Containerization and Cloud Services (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • A strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset, passionate about high‑impact projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in building, scaling, and maintaining sophisticated production environments
  • Advanced skills in system monitoring, alerting, reporting, metrics tracking, and software reliability engineering
  • An exceptional sense of product development with a keen focus on user experience and customer needs
  • A commitment to ongoing personal and professional development

Nice To Have

  • Experience or interest in embedded software engineering – developing application software for embedded systems (Linux‑based IoT medical device). Experience with hardware interfaces (GPIO, camera control, serial communication) and embedded Linux systems is a plus, though not required. Note: This is application software development on embedded hardware, not low‑level firmware engineering.
  • Experience or interest in the design, training, and optimization of computer vision models for blood diagnostics, including object detection and classification models. Work across the ML lifecycle from data preparation and model training to deployment and performance monitoring.

Commure is committed to creating and fostering a diverse team. We are open to all backgrounds and levels of experience, and believe that great people can always find a place. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants throughout the application process.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @getathelas.com, @commure.com or @augmedix.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Job Description

Software DevOps Engineer (Analista de Automação de Sistemas Sênior)

Você fará parte da Área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento de Software em Varginha/MG, um time com atuação global. Atuará diretamente na área responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de produtos médicos, especificamente na área de Hospital Patient Monitoring (atualmente atuando em monitores multi-paramétricos gerais e obstétricos).

Only CVs en English will be considered

Sua função:

  • Contribuir para automatizar processos de desenvolvimento de software, visando acelerar ciclos de lançamento e fortalecer ciclos de feedback, promovendo um ambiente de desenvolvimento mais ágil.

  • Participar na implementação e manutenção de sistemas de controle de versão robustos, análise de qualidade/segurança e pipelines de CI/CD, componentes essenciais que garantem a entrega contínua e segura de código dos ambientes de desenvolvimento para produção.

  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de scripts de automação de construção e deploy, trabalhando para otimizar fluxos de trabalho, aumentando a eficiência e a confiabilidade.

  • Colaborar com o time de desenvolvimento para gerenciar efetivamente lançamentos de código e solucionar rapidamente problemas de produção, garantindo interrupção mínima das operações.

  • Integrar-se ao processo de aprendizado relacionado às metodologias e melhores práticas de DevOps, aproveitando oportunidades para aumentar a produtividade da equipe e melhorar a qualidade das entregas.

  • Compreender os requisitos dos clientes e contribuir com insights para alinhar as iniciativas de DevOps com os objetivos de negócios mais amplos, aumentando o valor geral das entregas.

  • Desempenhar um papel nos processos de tomada de decisão orientados por dados, reunindo ativamente e analisando métricas pertinentes, auxiliando na identificação de áreas para melhoria e otimização.

  • Adotar uma postura proativa em relação ao desenvolvimento profissional, buscando ativamente oportunidades para expandir o conhecimento e a expertise em tecnologias e metodologias de DevOps, promovendo o crescimento pessoal e da equipe.

Você é a pessoa certa se possuir:

  • Ensino superior completo em cursos de Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Software, Controle e Automação ou afins.

  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, grande iniciativa, mentalidade de melhoria contínua e foco nas necessidades dos nossos clientes (Hospitais e Pacientes);

  • Desejo constante de adquirir novos conhecimentos e desenvolver habilidades.

  • +3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos de software

  • Inglês intermediário desejável

  • Conhecimento em: Linux, Build Servers, CI/CD, Git, Python ou outra linguagem de script, Groovy Scripts, Makefile

  • Conhecimentos em C/C++, C# são diferenciais

  • Familaridade com ferramentas como Docker, Ansible, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Artifactory são desejáveis

Como trabalhamos juntos?

Acreditamos que geramos um impacto maior quando estamos juntos do que separados. Para nossos membros da equipe do escritório (semi-presencial), isso significa trabalhar de modo presencial ao menos três dias da semana em nosso escritório em Varginha/MG , para colaborar e estabelecer conexões com nosso time e as áreas pares.

Sobre a Philips

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia em saúde. Nós criamos toda a nossa empresa com base na crença de que todos os seres humanos são importantes e não vamos parar até que todos, em todos os lugares, tenham acesso aos cuidados de saúde de qualidade que todos nós merecemos. Requisitos

  1. Possuir experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em ambiente hospitalar, laboratorial ou veterinário.

  3. Possuir fortes capacidades de organização e gerenciamento de tempo, com atenção aos detalhes.
  4. Ser apaixonado por animais e possuir a compreensão dos desafios associados ao cuidado veterinário.

Se você é um profissonal dedicado e entusiasmado, apaixonado por animais, comunicativo e carismático, esta é uma excelente oportunidade pra você!

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Overview

Como é o ambiente de trabalho? Na Fundação Educandário, o trabalho é conduzido com propósito, método e colaboração . O ambiente combina autonomia com apoio constante, permitindo que cada profissional exerça suas funções com clareza de metas e foco em resultados.

O(a) Gerente de Desenvolvimento Institucional contará com estrutura completa para desempenhar suas atividades, incluindo notebook e celular corporativos, além de custeio integral das despesas relacionadas à captação, como deslocamentos, hospedagens, eventos e reuniões estratégicas.

A rotina é presencial em Ribeirão Preto , com interação direta com a Diretoria Executiva e integração constante com as equipes de Comunicação, Projetos e Financeiro. O clima é de confiança e corresponsabilidade, todos trabalham com objetivos comuns e métricas claras de desempenho , num contexto em que os resultados sociais importam tanto quanto os números financeiros.

O profissional contará ainda com apoio de uma pessoa dedicada às rotinas operacionais e administrativas de captação , possibilitando que seu foco esteja nas atividades estratégicas, de relacionamento e na execução prática da captação de recursos.

Sobre a Fundação Educandário

Sobre a Fundação Educandário “Cel. Quito Junqueira” foi criada em 1938 com um propósito que segue guiando todas as nossas ações: transformar de forma permanente a vida de crianças e adolescentes em vulnerabilidade social.

Com 87 anos de história, somos hoje uma instituição que democratiza o acesso à educação e à cultura de qualidade, atendendo mais de 2.200 alunos, formando anualmente 650 profissionais da rede pública e recebendo 180 mil visitas por ano em nossas iniciativas culturais.

Atuamos em quatro frentes principais

  • Colégio Camillo de Mattos: oferece educação infantil e ensino fundamental integral, com 700 alunos atendidos gratuitamente.
  • Escolas Municipais Dr. Fábio dos Santos Musa e Geny Biagioni Veiga: geridas pela Fundação via Parceria Público- Privada, atendem mais de 1.500 crianças da educação infantil, com nutrição, uniformes, material escolar e atividades de desenvolvimento integral.
  • Biblioteca Sinhá Junqueira: espaço cultural vivo de Ribeirão Preto, com mais de 180 mil visitantes anuais e uma agenda de palestras, oficinas, shows e exposições.
  • Programa de Formação de Profissionais da Rede Pública: capacita gestores e professores de 102 escolas em 14 municípios, impactando 65 mil alunos por ano, com base em práticas de gestão escolar, equidade e melhoria da aprendizagem.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência sólida e comprovada em captação de recursos , disposta a assumir papel protagonista na sustentabilidade e expansão dos projetos da Fundação.

Trata-se de uma posição estratégica, mas também de execução prática: o(a) Gerente de Desenvolvimento Institucional será a principal liderança responsável por garantir o financiamento das ações da Fundação, tanto na manutenção quanto na ampliação dos programas existentes e futuros.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Entre as responsabilidades: Elaborar e executar o plano operacional de captação de recursos, com metas claras de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Conduzir todas as etapas práticas de captação, desde a prospecção de doadores e empresas parceiras até a formalização de parcerias, renovações e prestação de contas.
  • Coordenar a escrita, submissão e acompanhamento de projetos em editais públicos e privados, nacionais e internacionais.
  • Ampliar a captação via leis de incentivo e destinação de recursos públicos (como ICMS, CONDECA, PRONON, PROAC e outros).
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com grandes doadores, fundações empresariais e investidores sociais, atuando com visão de longo prazo e alto padrão de entrega.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Comunicação, Projetos e Financeiro para integrar narrativa institucional, resultados e transparência, fortalecendo a reputação e credibilidade da Fundação.
  • Desenvolver materiais e apresentações institucionais personalizados para diferentes perfis de doadores.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, reportar resultados e propor ajustes estratégicos.
  • Representar a Fundação em reuniões, eventos e fóruns relevantes do terceiro setor e de responsabilidade social corporativa.

  • Capacidade de articular estratégias multicanais (empresas, pessoas físicas, editais, leis de incentivo e eventos).
  • Habilidade para produzir e revisar propostas e relatórios com linguagem institucional de alto nível.

  • Excelente comunicação escrita e oral; facilidade para negociar e conduzir reuniões executivas.
  • Graduação completa em Administração, Relações Públicas, Marketing, Comunicação, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.

Hibrído, na região de Florianópolis - SC.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

Role Description

We’re seeking a Product Sales Expert (PSE) —a key individual contributor responsible for driving regional growth of a specific product or product group. In this role, you will translate company strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, enable sales teams with the right product expertise, and engage directly with customers to accelerate adoption and revenue.

For this position, strong experience in Mobile Identity is essential, as you will work closely with this product line to ensure successful market penetration and business growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own regional execution & growth: Build and run the regional business plan for your product(s) with clear revenue and margin targets.
  • Enable and sell: Train and support sellers, jump into strategic cycles, and negotiate independently end to end when needed.
  • Mobile Identity focus: Drive solutions, with working knowledge of number portability and security processes.
  • Work with MNOs: Engage mobile network operators and ecosystem partners to craft offers, integrations, and joint GTM motions.
  • Be the product champion: Stay on top of features, benefits, competitive moves, and market trends—be the region’s go-to expert.
  • Close the loop with HQ: Channel customer and competitor insights to HQ teams (PSMs, Product, PMM) to influence roadmap, packaging, and positioning.
  • Align to scale: Partner with HQ so product strategies ladder up to overall regional sales objectives.

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Proven selling experience (Product Sales, Sales Engineering, Solutions, or similar) with measurable impact on revenue.
  • Mobile Identity background: Hands-on experience selling/implementing identity solutions with operators (e.g., number verification, KYC, fraud/SIM-swap), understanding number portability and security processes.
  • MNO experience: Comfortable navigating the mobile operator commercial and technical ecosystem (stakeholders, partnerships, co-sell motions).
  • Independent negotiation: Capable of running complex, multi-stakeholder deals on your own when required.
  • Stakeholder management & communication: Effective bridge between regional sales and global PSM/Product/PMM teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • GTM strategy: Ability to design and execute a regional GTM (account prioritization, motions, channels, pricing/packaging).
  • A track record selling identity solutions into banks, fintechs, wallets, super apps, e-commerce, ride-hailing, or other high-verification industries.
  • Multi-country regional experience and partnerships with carriers/operators.

Benefits

  • Dental Insurance

  • Meal Voucher

A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.

Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 47.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2019, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 4,56 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

description:
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2024, the company reported approximately $17 billion in annual sales - close to 90% of which were in the Americas - 44,000 employees, and 40 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

The team you will be a part of

The Global Information Technology team plays a strategic role in driving technology and digital transformation across the company. The Data and AI team is responsible for designing, delivering, and evolving technology solutions to improve data usage and drive long-term business results.

This role in summary

We are seeking a skilled Analytics Engineer to join our data team and bridge the gap between raw data and business-ready analytics. This role focuses on designing, building, and maintaining analytics-oriented data models and pipelines, ensuring reliable, well-structured data for dashboards, reports, and advanced analysis. The Analytics Engineer works closely with BI teams, data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders, transforming data into trusted analytical assets that support decision‑making.

Your responsibilities will include

Designs and builds analytical data models prioritized by D&A (with support from the Analytics Lead and Data Product Owner);

Develops, tests, and maintains transformation logic (SQL/Dataform) across Silver and Gold layers;

Defines, documents, and maintains business KPIs and semantic definitions (single source of truth);

Performs and documents data validation tests (quality checks, reconciliation, metric validation);

Supports Data Product Owners (BI Teams and Data Science Teams) during UAT and metric validation;

Collaborates with Data Engineers to ensure reliable upstream data ingestion and proper modeling grain;

Supports analytical model deployment through pull requests and downstream validation.

Follows Data Architecture, Semantic Layer standards, and Data Governance policies.

Documents analytical models, business rules, and metric logic (Project documentation & Product documentation – KT);

Partners with BI teams to optimize datasets for reporting tools (Lookerstudio, Tableau, etc.);

Optimizes performance of analytical datasets (aggregations, partitioning strategy alignment, cost awareness);

Supports and trains Analytics/BI teams on new datasets, KPI definitions, and semantic models (KT);

Monitors data freshness, metric consistency, and business logic integrity post‑deployment.

Hands‑on experience designing and maintaining analytical data models in BigQuery (Silver/Gold layers)

Strong proficiency in SQL (BigQuery or similar), including joins, window functions, aggregations, CTEs, and performance‑aware query design;

Strong proficiency in SQL for BigQuery

  • Window functions
  • Aggregations
  • Query performance optimization

Solid understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)

  • Fact and dimension tables
  • Surrogate keys
  • Basic Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) concepts

Experience implementing data quality validations:

  • Null checks
  • Referential integrity validation

Experience supporting UAT with BI teams and business stakeholders

Working knowledge of Cloud Composer (Airflow) and data dependency orchestration concepts

Understanding of how analytical modeling decisions impact Tableau (or similar BI tools) performance

Proficiency with Git‑based workflows, pull requests, and SQL code reviews

Working knowledge of GCP fundamentals:

  • IAM roles
  • Service accounts
  • Dataset‑level access control
  • Basic cost governance awareness

Ability to document transformation logic, KPI definitions, and business rules following enterprise standards

Preferred skills and experiences

Exposure to Dataflow and Pub/Sub, understanding upstream ingestion patterns

Experience working with SAP (ECC, BW, or S/4) or enterprise ERP systems

Experience with Dataform or structured SQL transformation frameworks

Experience optimizing BigQuery performance, including:

  • Aggregated tables

Exposure to data governance and metric standardization practices

Experience working in large‑scale enterprise environments

Exposure to data observability concepts (freshness monitoring, reconciliation dashboards)

Experience participating in Knowledge Transfer (KT) activities and supporting sustain teams

Professional working proficiency in English (preferred)

Exposure to GenAI‑assisted development tools for SQL or documentation automation

What we offer

1 day of work from home per week;

Flexible hours

“No dress code”

Gympass

Transportation allowance, bus, or free parking at the company

On‑site meals

Benefits such as payroll deduction or social loan, health insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, and a private pension plan compatible with the market;

Employee Support Program, with 24‑hour assistance from legal, social, financial, and psychological assistants.

Childcare or nursery assistance at the company.

Services available on‑site: beauty salon and aesthetics, an internal bank branch, laundry, a cafeteria, a restaurant, and a breastfeeding room.

Two weeks of remote work from anywhere;

After 5 years with the company, eligible employees can take four weeks of paid leave.

Discount on products through Compra Certa.

Discount on insurance (pet, car, home, bicycle, travel, and others);

Extended maternity/paternity leave.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

O eletricista instalador é responsável por executar instalações elétricas completas de grupos geradores e seus sistemas auxiliares com alto nível técnico, autonomia moderada e forte domínio de comandos, interligações e infraestrutura.   • Executar instalações elétricas completas de grupos geradores, QTA/QTS, quadros auxiliares e sistemas de interligação.
  • Realizar passagem de cabos de força, comando e comunicação com autonomia.

  • Apoiar montagens mecânicas simples relacionadas à instalação elétrica.
  • Acompanhar vistoria técnica, preparação de frentes de trabalho e conferência de materiais.
  • Guiar Eletricistas Júnior na execução segura e correta das atividades.
  • Seguir rigorosamente NR-10, NR-35, normas técnicas e padrões internos da DWT.
  • Registrar informações de obra: fotos, checklist, apontamentos e registros para relatórios.
  • Organizar materiais, ferramentas e manter o ambiente de trabalho seguro e eficiente.

title: Director
description:
We are seeking a Director, Programmatic Revenue & Ad Monetization to own the end-to-end programmatic strategy across our digital portfolio. In this highly technical and commercially driven role, you will drive measurable yield and revenue growth by optimizing our existing ad stack (including Prebid and header bidding), owning strategic demand partnerships (SSPs/DSPs), and building scalable monetization frameworks to rapidly integrate future acquisitions.

Success requires a product-first mindset. You will partner closely with product, engineering, and our Data & Decision Science teams to leverage RTB auction mechanics, maximize ad-supported user LTV, and position advertising as a core growth lever across the business.

Employment Type

This is a full-time independent contractor position. We are not currently hiring for direct employee positions.

Location

This is a fully remote position. Work where you perform your best.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a holistic monetization roadmap to achieve quarterly top-line revenue targets across display, video, and in-app inventory
  • Develop and implement yield strategies—optimizing price floors, Unified Pricing Rules (UPR), and auction dynamics—while running experiments to balance revenue, user engagement, and long‑term LTV
  • Build frameworks that standardize ad-tech operations and enable rapid integration and monetization of newly acquired digital assets
  • Architect and oversee the performance of the programmatic stack, including header bidding wrappers (Prebid, Amazon TAM), mediation platforms, and primary ad servers
  • Oversee SDK integrations and proactively resolve latency, render rate, and revenue leakage issues to ensure smooth delivery at scale
  • Own and negotiate strategic relationships with SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, and agency trading desks to secure premium demand and favorable commercial terms
  • Expand high-value demand channels through the growth of Private Marketplace (PMP) and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals
  • Partner with Data & Decision Science to define KPIs, interpret performance metrics, and translate insights into actionable, revenue‑driving decisions
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to guide the ad product roadmap, ensuring performance‑optimized and privacy‑compliant placements that maximize monetization.
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high‑performing ad operations and yield team, fostering a culture of rigorous testing, optimization, and operational excellence

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or analytical field (Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or Business Analytics) or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of professional experience in ad‑tech or digital monetization, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role focused on yield strategy
  • Proven track record of success in owning programmatic revenue for both mobile apps (iOS/Android) and web‑based products, with deep experience in SDK and web‑based implementations
  • Expert‑level technical fluency in the programmatic ecosystem, including RTB mechanics, OpenRTB protocols, unified auctions, and MRAID standards
  • Hands‑on mastery of the modern ad‑tech stack, specifically Ad Servers (e.g., Google Ad Manager), Header Bidding wrappers (e.g., Prebid, Amazon TAM), and mediation platforms (e.g., AppLovin MAX)
  • Deep technical knowledge of demand partners (e.g., Magnite, Index Exchange, PubMatic) and the evolving commercial dynamics of global DSPs
  • Proficiency in high‑level technical QA for ad tags, tracking pixels, and SDK integrations to identify and resolve delivery discrepancies and latency
  • Strong analytical horsepower to interpret complex bid metrics and pricing trends via BI tools; proven ability to partner with Data Science teams to translate LTV modeling and experiments into high‑growth yield strategies
  • Comprehensive knowledge of user privacy frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, and platform‑specific requirements like Apple’s ATT and Google’s Privacy Sandbox
  • Exceptional problem‑solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Master's degree or higher in a quantitative field
  • Advanced understanding of quantitative methods (Statistics, Econometrics, or Computer Science)
  • Success in leading the technical and commercial integration of acquired digital assets within private equity, app aggregator, or technology holding company environments
  • Hands‑on experience with server‑side solutions (e.g., Prebid Server) or a history of contributing to open‑source ad‑tech projects that enhance yield and scalability
  • Proven ability to navigate the unique monetization and brand safety challenges of high‑traffic User‑Generated Content (UGC), chat, or VoIP platforms
  • Specialized knowledge of the browser extension ecosystem, specifically regarding monetization opportunities, ad policies, and technical constraints within the Chrome Web Store
  • A track record of designing and executing complex \"Ad Load vs. Retention\" experiments to identify the optimal balance between aggressive revenue and user engagement
  • Established relationships and active participation in industry leadership groups such as IAB Tech Lab, Prebid.org, or other programmatic working committees

  • About Salesforce and SharePoint

    Salesforce is a global software platform that helps track and manage the full lifecycle of gaming equipment across multiple Studio locations, enabling reliable traceability on both global and local scales. Atuar como responsável pela esteira Operacional de Sustentação , conduzindo todas as etapas desde a aceitação formal da proposta comercial até a liberação em Produção. Ter forte atuação em práticas de PMO , garantindo fluidez, governança, comunicação clara e acompanhamento dos indicadores-chave.

Gestão da Formalização e Contratos.

  • Organizar, junto ao parceiro, toda a documentação e ficha cadastral necessária para análise de compliance e formalização da parceria;
  • Enviar documentos ao time de Compliance e acompanhar o processo até sua conclusão;
  • Elaborar o contrato, garantir o fluxo de assinatura e cumprimento dos prazos e políticas internas.

  • Planejar etapas, prazos, entregáveis, responsáveis e riscos;
  • Conduzir ritos-chave, como Kickoff Interno, Kickoff Externo, reuniões semanais e checkpoints;
  • Atualizar a esteira de CAAS API e BAAS API, garantindo visão clara do pipeline;
  • Monitorar KPIs, principalmente o tempo em dias de cada etapa, propondo melhorias;
  • Assegurar governança entre Comercial, Produtos, Compliance, Jurídico, Tecnologia, Sustentação e Suporte;
  • Acompanhar pré-implantação, implantação, Signoff e Produção Assistida, assegurando SLAs e transição adequada ao Suporte.

Comunicação e Relacionamento.

  • Atuar como ponto central de comunicação entre áreas internas e parceiros;
  • Prever riscos, comunicar desvios e alinhar expectativas antecipadamente;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva ao parceiro desde o início da jornada.

O que esperamos de você.

  • Vivência com processos administrativos, sustentação comercial e/ou implantação de projetos;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de priorização;
  • Boa comunicação com parceiros e áreas internas;
  • Proatividade, senso de dono e foco em entrega;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão (Excel, CRMs, plataformas internas, dashboards ou ferramentas de PMO).

Diferenciais que contam pontos.

  • Experiência com governança de projetos, ritos de PMO, indicadores e gestão de riscos;
  • Vivência no setor financeiro, BAAS ou CAAS;

Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced, business-centric professional to join the Bunge Technology (BT) organization. The BTP team will be responsible for driving the vision and defining the BT roadmap for business and function domains at Bunge. This team will work with Bunge’s senior executives to align on the business and functional outcomes technology must deliver, be the single point of contact to the business, and ensure the BT ecosystem is delivering as planned through an agreed set of OKRs.

This role will partner closely with business stakeholders, BBS partners, finance partners, HR partners, and technology delivery partners. The role reports to the BTP Leader in the BT organization.

description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 400 people spread across Asia‑Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

The Role

We’re looking for a Security Operations Analyst to support and strengthen security across Megaport. In this role, you’ll help monitor our security systems, investigate alerts, and respond to potential threats across our environment.

You’ll work closely with our security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to identify and analyze security situations, support incident responses, and help improve the tools we use daily. You’ll also be responsible for providing day‑to‑day security support across the business and helping ensure security best practices are kept.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, is comfortable working in a fast‑moving and global environment, and is passionate about cybersecurity.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Administer and operate security information and event management (SIEM) technologies and associated processes as a BAU function including the cultivation of cyber threat intelligence, threat models, and use‑case and the implementation and refinement of detection rules.
  • Onboarding of additional data sources to the SIEM, correlating data across diverse technologies and environments.
  • Manage the response process and conduct end‑to‑end incident investigation. including analysis of attack artifacts to establish incident scope, impact assessment and containment strategies.
  • Manage the technical vulnerability management process including monitoring of disclosure sources, evaluation of penetration test report, the use of vulnerability scanning solutions, and engaging IT system owners to assist with evaluation and remediation.
  • Manage and support security solutions such as EDR, ZTNA and DLP.
  • Go beyond finding security issues and work to provide solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise regarding architecture and implementation design of new solutions.
  • Provide general security support in the continued uplift and improvement of the environment.

What We Are Looking For - Some of the following

  • Proficient English required, as this role involves regular written and verbal communication with global teams and stakeholders.
  • Expertise in SIEM solutions within diverse physical and cloud environments.
  • Working, up‑to‑date knowledge of potential exploits, attacker tools, techniques, procedures, and managing threat intelligence sources.
  • Experience with native cloud security tools.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning solutions and best practices.
  • Experience working with cloud network and application environments.
  • Exposure to incident response processes, procedures, methods, and tools.
  • Understanding of desktop and server operating systems.
  • Experience with network security (e.g., firewall, IDS/IPS, routing, encryption).Experience with host‑level security and hardening.
  • Understanding of SDLC security practices.
  • Current or past certifications (e.g., CC, Security+, relevant vendor certs).
  • A keen interest in security and ongoing learning.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environments
  • Birthday Leave
  • 12 weeks parental leave (after 12 months continuous service), and 5 days of study leave.
  • Creative, fun, and contemporary work environments
  • Motivated team of industry experts and plenty of learning opportunities
  • Celebrated success with internal awards programs
  • Health and wellness program
  • Generous performance bonus structure

title: Software Engineer, Athelas Home
description:
At Commure, our mission is to simplify healthcare. We have bold ambitions to reimagine the healthcare experience, setting a new standard for how care is delivered and experienced across the industry. Our growing suite of AI solutions spans ambient AI clinical documentation, provider copilots, autonomous coding, revenue cycle management and more — all designed for providers & administrators to focus on what matters most: providing care. Healthcare is a $4.5 trillion industry with more than $500 billion spent annually on administrative costs, and Commure is at the heart of transforming it. We power over 500,000 clinicians across hundreds of care sites nationwide — more than $10 billion flows through our systems and we support over 100 million patient interactions. With new product launches on the horizon, expansion into additional care segments, and a bold vision to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges, our ambition is to move from upstart innovator to the industry standard over the next few years. Commure was recently named to Fortune’s Future 50 list for 2025 and is backed by world-class investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Y Combinator, Lux, Human Capital, 8VC, Greenoaks Capital, Elad Gil, and more. Commure has achieved over 300% year-over-year growth for the past two years and this is only the beginning. Healthcare’s moment for AI-powered transformation is here, and we’re building the technology to power it. Come join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

About The Role

Commure is on the lookout for Software Engineers to join our Athelas Home Engineering team, playing a pivotal role in enhancing our FDA-cleared IoT medical device product. The Athelas Home is a portable device that segments and counts the hematology composition of an individual's blood. Our product captures high resolution imagery of a blood sample and utilizes an ML model to determine the concentration of white blood cells using a few drops of blood. Hardware, software, and chemistry come together in concert to produce a streamlined, efficient, and powerful diagnostics platform whose results are as accurate as gold-standard devices at a fraction of the cost. Today, these devices are deployed and active across the world, making bloodwork more comfortable for patients and more accessible for their doctors.

This position is perfect for someone who has experience with full stack software engineering; enjoys building new features and improving infrastructure, and has an interest in the medical device R&D space. You’ll be working in a small multi-functional engineering team comprised of chemical and hardware engineering, manufacturing, and quality.

What You’ll Do

  • Development of existing backend and frontend services for the Athelas device product: improving our infrastructure, architecting and building robust, scalable back-end service
  • Translate product requirements into technical solutions
  • Implementation of cybersecurity best practices throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, quality, and regulatory functions to ensure that production software systems meet both operational, security, and regulatory requirements
  • Utilize a stack comprising Python, Flask, React, Postgres, Kubernetes, Docker
  • Apply problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring the stability and performance of our systems
  • Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience required
  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience required, proficiency in Python
  • Deep expertise in developing and managing data pipelines and experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational database management systems
  • Advanced knowledge in Containerization and Cloud Services (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • A strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset, passionate about high-impact projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in building, scaling, and maintaining sophisticated production environments
  • Advanced skills in system monitoring, alerting, reporting, metrics tracking, and software reliability engineering
  • An exceptional sense of product development with a keen focus on user experience and customer needs
  • A commitment to ongoing personal and professional development

Nice To Have

  • Experience or interest in embedded software engineering – developing application software for embedded systems (Linux-based IoT medical device). Experience with hardware interfaces (GPIO, camera control, serial communication) and embedded Linux systems is a plus, though not required. Note: This is application software development on embedded hardware, not low-level firmware engineering.
  • Experience or interest in the design, training, and optimization of computer vision models for blood diagnostics, including object detection and classification models. Work across the ML lifecycle from data preparation and model training to deployment and performance monitoring.

Commure is committed to creating and fostering a diverse team. We are open to all backgrounds and levels of experience, and believe that great people can always find a place. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to all applicants throughout the application process.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @ getathelas.com , @ commure.com or @ augmedix.com . Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

title: Senior Engineer, Trading
description:
About the Job

zerohash is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to architect and build new features, as well as scaling a gateway to Finance 2.0. We are a high performing team looking for an equally ambitious and driven teammate. The right candidate for this position is detailed oriented, deeply technical and driven. You are eager to learn new technologies and complex systems. You build resiliency and scalability into the platform at every step. If you are looking to have a massive impact in a high-growth startup in one of the most exciting markets in decades, you will find the role challenging and rewarding in equal measure.

This is a fully remote role for a candidate based in LATAM.

#LI-Remote

Responsibilities

  • Support the company's vital business by contributing to the design and development of software in an event‑driven microservices environment
  • Develop microservices in Golang
  • Work with platform engineers to set up new services
  • Respond to production issues and alerts
  • When necessary, communicate directly with client technical teams

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience, preferably in the FinTech space
  • Deep Proficiency with Golang.
  • Understanding of SQL and database schema design
  • A humble and scrappy get‑it‑done mindset; you’re resourceful and in your element going from 0 to 1
  • Solid understanding of market structure, order types (Limit, Market, Stop, IOC,FOK), trade lifecycle and common risks associated with electronic trading
  • Excellent problem solving skills - can troubleshoot complex systems
  • Hands on experience developing, and maintaining high performance low‑latency trading systems
  • Comfort with ambiguity; the ability to independently lay out and test clear hypotheses and solve problems without well‑defined direction
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred

  • Bachelors in computer science or equivalent experience
  • Experience at a banking‑as‑a‑service, brokerage‑as a service, payment‑as‑a‑service business
  • Experience with digital assets
  • Experience with distributed systems design and messaging frameworks (e.g., Kafka, ZeroMQ or NATS) for data distribution and persistence

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin‑based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built‑in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance‑first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top‑tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we’re building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co‑workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co‑workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast‑paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

title: Gerente de enfermagem
description:
Buscamos uma Enfermeira Gerencial para liderar a excelência operacional, segurança e conformidade regulatória da Elite Clinic. Você será responsável por garantir que todos os processos de enfermagem funcionem com precisão, rastreabilidade e alinhamento com normas ANVISA, COFEN e COREN.

Esta é uma posição estratégica que combina gestão operacional, conformidade regulatória e liderança de equipe, garantindo que a clínica funcione como uma instituição de saúde de alta performance.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Gestão de Documentação e Conformidade

    Criar e manter POPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão), protocolos clínicos, manuais de boas práticas, registros padronizados e políticas de segurança do paciente. Garantir conformidade total com ANVISA, COFEN, COREN e NR-32.

  • Vigilância Sanitária

    Ser o ponto focal entre a clínica e órgãos reguladores. Preparar a clínica para inspeções, manter documentação organizada e implementar planos de ação para correção de não conformidades.

  • Gestão de Processos Operacionais

    Supervisionar acolhimento, triagem, administração de medicamentos, aplicação de procedimentos, monitoramento de pacientes, descarte de resíduos e limpeza/desinfecção de ambientes. Garantir técnica asséptica e segurança em todas as atividades.

  • Gestão de Estoque e Insumos

    Controlar inventário, manter níveis mínimos, gerenciar validade (FIFO), rastrear lotes de medicamentos e insumos, armazenar conforme especificações, implementar controles especiais para medicamentos controlados e reportar faltas críticas.

  • Central de Esterilização (CME)

    Implementar protocolos de esterilização, calibrar equipamentos, realizar testes de esterilidade, manter rastreabilidade de lotes, garantir armazenamento adequado de materiais esterilizados e processar materiais reutilizáveis conforme normas.

  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento

    Desenvolver programa de treinamento para novos colaboradores, realizar educação continuada, avaliar competências da equipe e manter registros de todos os treinamentos realizados.

  • Monitoramento de Indicadores

    Acompanhar taxa de infecção, eventos adversos, conformidade com POPs, satisfação do paciente e taxa de retrabalho. Implementar melhorias contínuas baseadas em dados.

Requisitos Técnicos

Formação e Experiência

  • Enfermeira com registro ativo no COREN
  • Mínimo 5 anos de experiência em enfermagem clínica
  • Mínimo 2 anos em gestão ou supervisão
  • Especialização em Saúde Pública, Gestão em Saúde, Enfermagem Estética ou Controle de Infecção (desejável)
  • Certificação em BLS/ACLS (desejável)

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Legislação sanitária (ANVISA, COFEN, COREN, NR-32)
  • Processos de esterilização e validação
  • Farmacologia básica
  • Biossegurança e prevenção de infecções
  • Sistemas eletrônicos de prontuário e gestão

Competências

  • Liderança e motivação de equipes
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva
  • Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
  • Atenção aos detalhes e meticulosidade
  • Orientação a qualidade e melhoria contínua
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças

Indicadores de Desempenho

  • Conformidade com POPs ≥ 95%
  • Taxa de eventos adversos < 2%
  • Taxa de infecção < 1%
  • Disponibilidade de estoque ≥ 98%
  • Precisão de inventário ≥ 99%
  • Satisfação do paciente ≥ 9/10
  • Conformidade com Vigilância Sanitária 100%

O Que Oferecemos

  • Posição estratégica com impacto direto na qualidade e segurança
  • Ambiente de clínica premium com infraestrutura moderna
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e especialização
  • Equipe colaborativa e orientada a resultados
  • Possibilidade de progressão para cargos de maior responsabilidade

Sobre a Elite Clinic

Somos uma clínica premium comprometida com excelência operacional, segurança do paciente e conformidade regulatória. Operamos com processos rigorosos, indicadores de performance e uma cultura de alta qualidade.

Candidatos interessados, enviem seu CV e uma breve apresentação sobre sua experiência em gestão de enfermagem e conformidade regulatória.

title: Strategic Security Architect & Framework Designer
description:
Strategic Security Architect & Framework Designer

Job Overview

Budget: $3,500.00

Level: Senior

Location: Not specified

Job Posted: 09 Aug, 2025

Category: Cybersecurity

Project & Company Context

Our company is at a critical juncture of growth, with a complex and expanding IT footprint that includes on-premise, cloud (AWS/GCP), and hybrid components. While we have implemented various point-solutions for security over the years, we currently lack a unified, defensible security architecture. This reactive approach has resulted in security gaps, fragmented policy enforcement, and an inefficient incident response process. We are a highly committed organization dedicated to rectifying these issues strategically and proactively. We are seeking an expert Security Architect to not just find vulnerabilities, but to design a comprehensive, long-term, and scalable security framework that will protect our assets and build lasting customer trust.

Scope of Work & Deliverables

Phase 1: Comprehensive Security Assessment (20% of Project)

  • Task: Conduct a deep‑dive analysis of our entire IT infrastructure, including network segmentation, cloud configurations (IAM, VPC), and existing security controls.
  • Deliverable: A detailed "As‑Is" Security Posture Report, identifying all vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and policy gaps. This report must include a risk matrix with clear prioritisation (High, Medium, Low) and evidence for each finding.

Phase 2: Security Architecture Design & Blueprint (40% of Project)

  • Task: Based on the assessment, design a new, unified security architecture. This blueprint must be scalable and aligned with industry standards (e.g., NIST Cybersecurity Framework, Zero Trust principles). The architecture should cover network, cloud, application, and data security.
  • Deliverable: A comprehensive "To‑Be" Security Architecture Blueprint, including diagrams, a technical narrative, and a detailed list of recommended security controls, tools, and policies.

Phase 3: Implementation Roadmap & Handoff (30% of Project)

  • Task: Create a detailed, phased implementation roadmap. This is a crucial step for our internal team to follow. The roadmap must include timelines, resource allocation suggestions, and clear action items for each security initiative.
  • Deliverable: A "Security Implementation Roadmap" document and a handover session with our internal IT team, providing guidance and answering technical questions.

Phase 4: Post‑Project Support & Validation (10% of Project)

  • Task: Provide a period of support to ensure the successful initiation of the roadmap.
  • Deliverable: A post‑project support plan for the first 14 days, including a final review to validate that the implementation roadmap is sound and all questions are resolved.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Criteria

  • Completeness: The "As‑Is" report accurately reflects our security posture, and the "To‑Be" blueprint is comprehensive and actionable.
  • Strategic Alignment: The proposed architecture aligns with our business goals and future growth plans.
  • Clarity: All deliverables, especially the implementation roadmap, are clear, concise, and easily understood by our technical team.
  • Revision: The freelancer must be prepared for up to two rounds of revisions on the architecture blueprint to meet our precise needs.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Core Expertise:

  • Proven experience as a Security Architect, with a strong portfolio of designing and implementing security frameworks.
  • In‑depth knowledge of security standards (NIST, ISO 27001) and regulatory compliance (GDPR, SOC 2).
  • Expertise in both on‑premise and multi‑cloud security (AWS, GCP) including IAM, VPC, and encryption best practices.
  • Proficiency in security tools and technologies (e.g., SIEM, EDR, Firewall management).
  • A structured and methodical approach to problem‑solving.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong documentation abilities to create a lasting and useful resource for our company.
  • Duration: The total project is expected to be completed within 60 days.
  • Revisions: Includes up to 2 revisions of the main architecture blueprint.

Application Instructions

  • A cover letter outlining your experience in security architecture and why you are the right fit for this project.
  • A case study or portfolio demonstrating a similar project you have successfully completed.

Skills

  • Security architecture governance
  • IT strategy and planning
  • Cybersecurity controls and technologies

A Empresa

Empresa multinacional de origem europeia, com presença global e foco em tecnologias de materiais avançados e reciclagem. Atua em segmentos altamente especializados, como metais preciosos, catalisadores automotivos e materiais para baterias, sendo referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e processos industriais de alta complexidade. No Brasil, mantém operações industriais estratégicas que exigem elevado controle de qualidade, segurança e conformidade com normas ambientais e regulatórias, especialmente em regiões incentivadas como a Zona Franca de Manaus.

A posição

O profissional será responsável por coordenar as atividades fiscais da empresa, assegurando o correto cumprimento da legislação tributária vigente e o adequado recolhimento dos impostos indiretos e contribuições. Atuará na gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe, distribuindo demandas, acompanhando entregas e promovendo o aprimoramento técnico e comportamental. Terá papel ativo na implementação de novos sistemas e projetos fiscais, bem como na melhoria contínua dos processos internos. Também será responsável pela análise crítica da legislação, suporte a auditorias e atendimento às fiscalizações estadual e federal.

Responsabilidades

  • Estudar a legislação, acompanhar todas as alterações legais que impactam nas atividades da empresa, bem como prover as alterações necessárias nos sistemas informatizados para assegurar que os processos estejam de acordo com as novas disposições legais.
  • Coordenar a equipe em sua gestão de desenvolvimento individual bem como na distribuição e acompanhamento das atividades, fornecendo feedback e provendo recursos para o aprimoramento técnico da equipe, visando a entrega de obrigações e recolhimento dos tributos dentro do prazo legal bem como o desenvolvimento comportamental.
  • Acompanhar a equipe na implementação de novos sistemas tributários, trabalhando em conjunto com os key users, na realização de projetos sob demanda legal e de melhorias nos processos internos, visando melhor aproveitamento do tempo de cada um e manter a qualidade dos trabalhos executados.
  • Realizar a análise crítica & estratégica e interpretação da legislação que podem influenciar na tomada de decisão de um novo processo ou negócio assegurando assim o cumprimento dos requisitos legais.
  • Revisar o fechamento de todas as filiais através de relatórios demonstrativos a fim de assegurar o recolhimento correto dos impostos indiretos e contribuições (ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS e COFINS) e cumprimento legal.
  • Atendimento à auditoria interna e externa, através de apresentação de documentos solicitados para entrega e análise da auditoria.
  • Assegurar o controle do MICR atualizando as alterações tributárias e processos através de revisões periódicas dos procedimentos.
  • Atender à Fiscalização Estadual e Federal através do levantamento e apresentação de documentação solicitada para análise e conferência do Fisco.

Requisitos

  • Superior em Administração de Empresas ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Direito Tributário ou Planejamento Tributário;
  • Inglês avançado;
